headline: East Maui Water Board

meeting.summary: East Maui board hears of a $6 million draft West Maui water deal, picks state-meeting testifiers, and sets an August 17th Kula meeting.
meeting.recap: The East Maui Regional Community Board met Friday, July 17, with the vice chair leading.[[0:00:33]] A state Board of Land and Natural Resources meeting on East Maui water, planned for July 24th on Maui, was postponed.[[0:19:40]] The board voted to have two more members testify for it when the state land board takes up East Maui water.[[0:31:13]] A writer working with the Public Finance Initiative said he is writing about the board's governance model.[[0:59:56]] The board voted to hold its next meeting on August 17th.[[1:13:06]] Staff said the authority's next round of grants will give out $150,000.[[1:19:30]] The August 17th meeting will be at 5 p.m. at the Kula Community Center.[[1:41:44]] The board will meet again September 18th at 9 a.m.[[1:41:58]]
decided: The board voted to name two members, besides the chair and vice chair, to testify for it when the state land board takes up East Maui water.
meeting.next: The executive director will talk with the stakeholder meeting's guest speaker early next week to pick a topic.

moments.q: Film crew says a company "declined to be a part of the story"
"the people voted 64% of Maui voted for this board"
